description: ROI model for the Tulsa Applied AI Readiness Audit. This structure drives both the interactive calculator UI and the server-side projection math. Assumptions reflect current (2026) generally-available AI + automation capabilities for SMBs running Microsoft 365 / Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Power Automate, and modern LOB integrations.

industry.label: Which industry best describes your business?

admin_headcount.label: How many employees spend the majority of their time on administrative / back-office work?
admin_headcount.help_text: Include schedulers, CSRs, paralegals, dispatchers, billing clerks, and intake staff. Exclude licensed/revenue-producing roles.

loaded_labor_cost_per_hour.label: Average loaded labor cost per hour for those admin staff
loaded_labor_cost_per_hour.help_text: Loaded = wage + payroll taxes + benefits + overhead. Use our industry default if you're unsure.

global_assumptions.productivity_reinvestment_note: Not every saved hour converts to cash. We multiply raw labor savings by 0.85 to reflect the portion that realistically translates to revenue-producing work, reduced overtime, or deferred hiring.

calculations.implementation_cost_min: sum over selected processes of implementation_cost.min
calculations.implementation_cost_max: sum over selected processes of implementation_cost.max

ongoing_cost_assumptions.per_user_ai_license_note: Approximate blended cost of Copilot for Microsoft 365 ($30/user/month) across admin users. Adjust at pilot scope.
ongoing_cost_assumptions.platform_fixed_note: Average blended cost of Azure OpenAI consumption, Power Automate premium connectors, and marginal Purview/Intune licensing for a 20-200 person SMB.
